author: Nelev
body:
Stacked on #66 (base is that branch; retarget to `main` once it merges).

## Summary
- `GET /conversations/{id}/export` renders the stored conversation as a PDF on request, through the same user-scoped `get_conversation` as `GET /conversations/{id}` (someone else's conversation is a 404). No files are written, so `exports/`, `EXPORT_DIR` and the cleanup problem are gone.
- `export_conversation_pdf` (agent tool) now only reports the PDF as ready. The conversation id reaches it as runtime context, like the record id.
- UI: a Route Handler proxies the download with the session token, and a **Download PDF** link in the header shows when a conversation is open.

## Test plan
- [x] API: `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `pytest -q` (173 passed), including 200/404/401 for the export route and the id reaching the agent
- [x] UI: `lint`, `format:check`, `tsc --noEmit`, `test` (route handler and link)
- [ ] Manual: open a conversation, click Download PDF
